claims.claim: B has been running around in front of the TV
claims.attribute: B's behavior: running around in front of a TV

evidence.quote: Stop running around in front of the TV , will you ?

claims.adjudication_reason: Imperative 'Stop running around' solidly presupposes B is currently performing that action.

claims.claim: A tells B to sit and watch the TV
claims.attribute: A's instruction to B to sit and watch TV

evidence.quote: Why don ’ t you just sit and watch ?

claims.adjudication_reason: Explicit suggestion/proposal by A directed at B ('Why don't you just sit and watch?').

claims.claim: A tells B to stay away from something
claims.attribute: A instructing B to stay away

evidence.quote: Then stay away . Nobody's keeping you from doing that .

claims.adjudication_reason: Explicit imperative from A ('Then stay away') with clear speech act.

claims.claim: A intends to explain something to B later
claims.attribute: A's plan to explain something to B

evidence.quote: All right , I will explain it to you later on .

claims.adjudication_reason: Explicit statement of A's future intention ('I will explain it to you later on').

claims.claim: B did or offered something that is exactly what A wanted

evidence.quote: That's exactly what I want , thank you .

claims.adjudication_reason: 'That's exactly what I want' presupposes B did/offered something; the referent 'that' points to B's action.

claims.claim: B has asked or demanded that A explain something
claims.attribute: B has requested an explanation from A

evidence.quote: I will explain it to you later on

claims.adjudication_reason: 'I will explain it to you later' presupposes B has asked/demanded an explanation; reasonable inference from the conversational context of A responding to a request.

claims.claim: B has complained about or implied being prevented from doing something

evidence.quote: Nobody's keeping you from doing that

claims.adjudication_reason: 'Nobody's keeping you from doing that' presupposes B has complained about or implied being prevented; solid conversational inference from the defensive phrasing.
